title: VendID MRZ API: 200 response of POST /v1/mrz

format.description: TD3 passport (2 lines of 44), TD1 ID card (3 lines of 30), TD2 (2 lines of 36)

document_type.description: First 1-2 characters of the MRZ, e.g. P (passport), I, ID, A, C

issuing_state.description: ICAO 9303 three-letter code of the issuing state or organisation, e.g. AUT, D, UTO

surname.description: Primary identifier, filler '<' turned into spaces

given_names.description: Secondary identifier, names separated by single spaces

birth_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null if the MRZ date does not exist (e.g. unknown day written as <<)

sex.description: F, M, X, or empty when the MRZ has '<' (unspecified)

expiry_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null if the MRZ date does not exist

optional_data.description: Optional data field(s) as printed, e.g. a personal number

check_digits.description: ICAO 9303 check digits, recomputed. A 200 answer always has all four true.

mrz.description: The raw MRZ lines as read

ms.description: Time spent reading on our side, in milliseconds

specimen.description: Present only when the ICAO specimen passport (L898902C3) was read; such reads are free
